steps.title: Place the cill
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as esp2023_lock_gates.iam.
Place cill.ipt, right click and Place Grounded at Origin. The origin is on the lock centre line, on top of the cill.
steps.note: The concrete cill is where the gates seal at the bottom, and it holds the pintles.

steps.title: Fit the hinges
actions: Place bottom_pintle.ipt in each pocket, 2349 mm each side of the centre line. Insert four anchor_bolt.ipt (Content Center, or the part) through each base plate.
Place anchor_collar.ipt and collar_bush.ipt over each pivot, 5870 mm up, with the arm pointing into the wall. Place anchor_plate.ipt at the end of each arm with two more anchor bolts.
steps.note: The pintle takes the weight of the leaf. The anchor collar at the top stops it tipping forwards.

steps.title: Place the left leaf
actions: Place gate_leaf.iam (the sub-assembly from the gate leaf build steps).
Constrain > Insert: the pintle bush on to the left pintle. Mate the top journal axis to the collar axis.
Constrain > Angle: 18.43 degrees between the leaf and the line across the lock, so the mitre points upstream.
steps.note: Suppress the Angle constraint later so the leaf can turn on its hinge for the simulation.

steps.title: Mirror the right leaf
actions: Click Mirror. Pick gate_leaf.iam. Mirror plane: the YZ Plane (the lock centre line).
Leave the mitre seal out (only the left leaf has it). Constrain the right leaf to its pintle and collar.
steps.note: The two mitre posts close on to the 30 mm mitre seal.

steps.title: Inspection chambers
actions: Place inspection_chamber.ipt beside each quoin, 300 mm behind the pivot, its top at ground level (6000).
Place actuator_plinth.ipt in each chamber against the end wall, and control_panel.ipt on the end wall.
steps.note: The drive goes in a purpose-built chamber beside each gate, out of sight, as the brief asks.

steps.title: Fit the actuators
actions: Place pivot_pedestal.ipt on each plinth. Place actuator_body.ipt and Mate its rear eye to the pedestal; place actuator_motor.ipt under the tube.
Place actuator_rod.ipt in the tube bore (Mate axis to axis) and rod_end.ipt on the end of the rod.
Pin the rod end to the bracket on the leaf and the rear eye to the pedestal with pivot_pin.ipt.
steps.note: An electric actuator needs only the mains supply the brief offers, and has no hydraulic oil to leak into the canal.

steps.title: Sensors, CCTV and call points
actions: Place encoder_bracket.ipt on each anchor collar arm and position_encoder.ipt over the pivot, its shaft on the journal.
Place cctv_mast.ipt and cctv_camera.ipt on the far corner of each chamber, call_point_post.ipt and call_point.ipt on the near corner.
steps.note: The encoder tells the control centre the angle of each leaf; the cameras let it watch; the call point lets anyone stop the gates.

steps.title: Cover the chambers
actions: Place cover_panel.ipt in the rebate of each chamber and Pattern it: 3 along the chamber.
Inspect tab > Interference > Analyze Interference with the leaves shut, half open and open. Save.
steps.note: In the 3D viewer the covers are hidden at first so you can see the drive: tick them on in the parts list.
